title: Reproductive Competition and Reproductive Strategies
text: Males can inseminate many females, but females want to worry about the survival of each egg, and similarly again, this is pretty obvious in humans that a female, if she gets pregnant, is going to be spending nine months pregnant, and then breast feeds and won't get pregnant again, so it's at least a year and probably at least a year and a half before that female can get pregnant again. We almost always bear only one child with an occasional twin or so forth, so a very low rate of reproduction where a male doesn't have any such kind of limit. This does not mean that females are monogamous, because there are many other reasons why a female might want to have many mates. First of all, we'll see, she might want to get resources from many males. You'll see she sometimes will not mate with a male unless that male gives her some resource. She might want to mate with a variety of males because she can't tell which one has the best genes.
